label: example edition

lead.headline: A newspaper anyone can generate — evidence-tiered, signed, lens-wired
lead.dek: This edition was rendered by open-press from a single JSON file. Every claim below wears the tier its author gave it; combatant quotes hand off to captioneer automatically.

paragraphs.text: open-press turns a research result into a signed broadsheet. Feed it an edition.json; it renders standalone HTML, hashes the bytes, optionally ed25519-signs them, and files the edition in a manifest.
The framework's only fixed spine is the evidence tier: a number without a stamp does not publish. Officials always say they have no shortage of anything.
paragraphs.quote: We've got no shortage of munitions.

sections.headline: Four tiers, one discipline
sections.dek: Verified survives adversarial checking; reported is anonymous-official journalism; claimed is a combatant's own word; refuted is executed in public.

tiles.note: one file becomes one signed edition
pure Node; no build, no network

items.text: node press.mjs new "Your Paper" — scaffold press.config.json
write an edition.json (this file is one)
node press.mjs build edition.json — render, hash, sign, archive

lines.label: TIER EVERYTHING
lines.text: No naked numbers; an untiered figure is unpublishable — run an empty column instead.

lines.label: CORRECT IN PUBLIC
lines.text: Refuted claims are struck through, not deleted; the near-miss is the vaccination.

lines.label: PEOPLE, NOT TARGETS
lines.text: Read counts back into the people they count.

corrections.claim: This framework fact-checks for you and tells you what is true.
corrections.note: refuted — the press renders and tiers; the tiering judgment is the author's, and the reader's own eye (the lens) is one door down.

press: 1 JSON file · 0 dependencies · rendered by open-press · signed if PRESS_SIGN_HEX is set
method: This demo edition ships with the framework so you can see the shape of an edition.json before you write your own. Diff it against the renderer in lib/render.mjs to learn every block type.
